end.summary:
Practised identifying standing, sleeping and slanting straight lines.
Om identified 2 of 4 examples without help.
They described standing lines as up-down and sleeping lines as left-right.
They continued to say a tilted line is not straight; this was not corrected by the end.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the three line directions using body positions and familiar examples such as sleeping, standing, slides and ladders. Om clearly described standing and sleeping lines and used “slanting line” for a tilted line. The mix-up that a tilted line cannot be straight remained at the end; at home, draw slanting lines with a ruler held at different angles and check that each line is still straight.
